card.name: Leading zero in dates and IDs
card.fires_on: The digit 0 (or sometimes 3) that begins a two-digit number right after a break such as a space or hyphen. It appears in dates, report numbers, study codes and durations.

modes.label: Dates
modes.description: Leading zero of the day number in a citation or news date.

modes.label: Study and report numbers
modes.description: Leading zero inside a trial, study or technical report code.

modes.label: Durations
modes.description: Leading zero of a count of nights or days in a travel itinerary.

card.writes: It suppresses other digit tokens, so it pushes the next token away from another digit.
card.plain: It marks the first digit of a zero-padded number, like the 0 in 02 Feb or Study 0761-010.
